tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250chos dbang bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs skong zlog 'gres byang*/ 1$0000300mi mngon dbyings nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'di la brtan par bzhugs: gnyis su med par phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul: thugs dam skong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bskang ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis bskang: sgrol ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sgrol: sbyor ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sbyor: ye sbyor ye sgrol chen pos thugs dam bskang: thugs dam gnyan po skong ba'i dam rdzas ni: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi dang: khyad par rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang: 'khor ba rgyu las bsgral ba'i rakta dang: rnam dag rgyu bsgral bam chen rdzas mchog dang: 'bru bcud stong la sbyar ba'i dza gad dang: phyi nang mchod pa tshogs kyi yo byad kyis: bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam gnyan po bskang: nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar mdzod: tshe dbang bsod nams longs spyod rgyas par mdzod: khams gsum srid gsum gdul bya dbang du sdus: gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po tshar chod cig: ༈

spro na zlog byang ni/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: yas kyi bdud kha g.yos pa zlog: mas kyi sri ru ldang ba zlog: pha tshan nang gi rgyab 'dre zlog: dar tshan nang gi stong 'dre zlog: g.yas nas pho brgyas mda' bdar zlog: g.yon nas mo brgyas dug g.yos zlog: rgyab nas mi gsum gros byed zlog: mdun nas rta gsum srab 'cha' zlog: 'ug pa spang la dgod pa zlog: srin bya gad khar 'bod pa zlog: log la wa spyang brgyal ba zlog: srod la khyim bya 'tsher ba zlog: tho rangs sgo khyi ngu ba zlog: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: ban bon ngan pa'i sngags zor zlog: lo kag zla kag king kang zlog: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams zlog: dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad zlog: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs rnams zlog: rtsis byas rde 'u nag pa zlog: mo ngan rmi lam ngan pa zlog: mi nag skye bo'i ya ga zlog: bran 'khor ngan pa'i dmod mchu zlog: pho bdud de ni g.yas su bhyo: mo bdud de ni g.yon du bhyo: spyi bdud de ni mkha' la bhyo: zlog sgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: ngan pa thams cad sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la bhyo bhyo: zlog zlog: drag sngags dang*/ bdud pra mā ra ya rbad nan: kha la dza ma ling rbad nan: ra tsa dun ling shag rbad nan: shig shig dum dum rbad nan: tshal pa tshal pa rbad nan: khroṃ khroṃ bhyo rbad nan: rmugs rmugs rbad nan: tir tir rbad nan: tshal tshal rbad nan: zhes bzla//
